bro_what1472: Wendel What left his mother, who writes every Sunday behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a frozen apple. The men noticed at once that he shares cigarettes but never smokes.
The rain did not stop once. Wendel What slept standing up, wedged against the wall of R-S12, and dreamt of dry socks.
Wendel What hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint.
Wendel What cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Wendel What counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Wendel What listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Wendel What was hit in the forearm at R-S12. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Hugo Adamjedlicka of the Concord (@adamjedlicka28). The clerk counted the names twice. Wendel What is number 425 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Wendel What helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
c_crash_trash_art: Jonas Art stepped off the supply cart at P-F17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Across from P-F17, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Jonas Art saw it. Rafael "Shadow" Ali was badly wounded. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Jonas Art wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
calmherculies500: Felix "Lucky" Calmherculie arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a cracked shaving mirror and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Felix "Lucky" Calmherculie aimed just below it. Wendel "Rabbit" Bfitzy was gravely wounded. A sniper's bullet hit Felix "Lucky" Calmherculie at U-F10. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Teodor Ennisjr of the Concord (@dawkins.ennisjr). Felix "Lucky" Calmherculie was killed on watch at U-F10. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Teodor Ennisjr of the Concord (@dawkins.ennisjr).

The papers connected Zeno "Doc" Calmherculie to Felix "Lucky" Calmherculie. The men took longer to learn Zeno "Doc" Calmherculie's own habits, but they made the effort. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Zeno "Doc" Calmherculie shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
ewalters120: Nils Ewalters came up on Day 6 carrying news from Brennmoor. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Nils Ewalters tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing. A letter from home reached Nils Ewalters before dusk. Nils Ewalters read it twice and slept a little easier.

The relief column arrived early. Nils Ewalters made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep. A letter from home reached Nils Ewalters before dusk. Nils Ewalters read it twice and slept a little easier.

A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Jakub Mccooper's name scratched on it. Nils Ewalters kicked it back. It did not come again. A letter from home reached Nils Ewalters before dusk. Nils Ewalters read it twice and slept a little easier. The transfer made Nils Ewalters a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Nils Ewalters ran six messages in one night. The last one was a request for more runners. A letter from home reached Nils Ewalters before dusk. Nils Ewalters read it twice and slept a little easier.

In the dark of the Hegemony trench Nils Ewalters hit Karel Check with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@no_one_here_to_check) Night raid. Nils Ewalters crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Nils Ewalters. Nils Ewalters felt a hard tug at his hip at R-S10. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Gustav Ethanlam of the Hegemony (@ethanlam724). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Nils Ewalters stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Nils Ewalters before dusk. Nils Ewalters read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nils Ewalters's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-S10 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A letter from home reached Nils Ewalters before dusk. Nils Ewalters read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Nils Ewalters answered to number 386. Grey Mill is lost. Nils Ewalters heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
gregrohlck: Gustav "Rabbit" Gregrohlck told the sergeant he was a tram conductor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Gustav "Rabbit" Gregrohlck joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Gustav "Rabbit" Gregrohlck stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Gustav "Rabbit" Gregrohlck asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-R18, Gustav "Rabbit" Gregrohlck listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
itz_fabian0120: They issued Jonas Fabian a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a letter he never sent in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Jonas Fabian wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Brass cases piled up around Jonas Fabian's boots at S-C10. Out of all those rounds, one found Quentin Stefan, gravely wounded. Jonas Fabian did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Jonas Fabian fired back. Jakub Ronne was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Fabian. Jonas Fabian read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The clerk counted the names twice. Jonas Fabian is number 757 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Jonas Fabian during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
loganarneson_: The sergeant gave Karel "Smokes" Loganarneson a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Karel "Smokes" Loganarneson could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. After what happened at Sorrow Copse, Karel "Smokes" Loganarneson asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.

Karel "Smokes" Loganarneson counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Silas "Brick" Little was gravely wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel "Smokes" Loganarneson. Karel "Smokes" Loganarneson read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Karel "Smokes" Loganarneson watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
lowelleast08: In Rosenau, Isidor Lowelleast was a stonemason. In R-F11, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a stonemason again.
Isidor Lowelleast received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
The patrol returned one at a time. Isidor Lowelleast held the entrance clear and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Drowned Farm. Isidor Lowelleast fired; Clement "Lucky" Johnrant pulled the bucket down. A sign later appeared: 'Water costs enough already.' From Verdel Ridge the Concord guns have a clear view. Isidor Lowelleast wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A shell burst in the trench at R-F11. Isidor Lowelleast was thrown against the wall and did not get up. The bearers came at a run.
Isidor Lowelleast lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.

Isidor Lowelleast spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Isidor Lowelleast folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
There was no room for Isidor Lowelleast. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.

The House of Lowelleast sent Felix Lowelleast after Isidor Lowelleast. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Number 44 on the early rolls: Felix Lowelleast. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F11 and grazed Felix Lowelleast's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Nils Averelle of the Concord (@averelle_3d).
Felix Lowelleast's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Felix Lowelleast polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Felix Lowelleast was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F11. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Oskar Haggis of the Concord (@ferg_haggis). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-F11 changed before the cheering ended. Felix Lowelleast shouldered another load.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F11. Felix Lowelleast took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Leopold "Whistle" Kagr of the Concord (@k4a.gr). Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Felix Lowelleast helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
michigangamer: On Day 8 Silas Michigangame took a post at S-S14 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He collects shell fuses, and the men liked him for it.
A shell landed close to S-S14. When the dust settled Silas Michigangame was still there, holding a tin whistle, laughing without sound.

Silas Michigangame went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Norbert Cheese was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@halo_of_cheese) Silas Michigangame jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Casimir Cbeattie. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@cbeattie.1770) News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S14 with the rations. Silas Michigangame ate while listening to the revised orders.

Silas Michigangame dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Silas Michigangame is number 520. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-S14. Silas Michigangame has learned to walk bent double.
poopdoop0224: By the time Severin Poopdoop reached T-F13, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Severin Poopdoop wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Severin Poopdoop was hit in the forearm at T-F13. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Severin Drowning of the Hegemony (@drowning.in._). From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Severin Poopdoop wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
prohunterwh: Edmund "Tin" Prohunterwh came from Ashford Vale, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Edmund "Tin" Prohunterwh stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Edmund "Tin" Prohunterwh went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Edmund "Tin" Prohunterwh is number 640. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-C7. Edmund "Tin" Prohunterwh has learned to walk bent double.
sandorthehound: Nobody saw Nils Sandorthehou arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in T-F14, and a quiet chaplain under it.

Nils Sandorthehou was hit through the chest at T-F14. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Marek Otakujake of the Concord (@otakujake_). Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Nils Sandorthehou was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle. Nils Sandorthehou's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Nils Sandorthehou could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

A surgeon stopped at Nils Sandorthehou's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news. A letter from home reached Nils Sandorthehou before dusk. Nils Sandorthehou read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at T-F14 changed before the cheering ended. Nils Sandorthehou shouldered another load.
shadowizard__: Leopold Shadowizard introduced himself as a schoolteacher from Dunmarrow. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F8, Leopold Shadowizard listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Leopold Shadowizard approved the method. The transfer made Leopold Shadowizard a sniper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Otto Elitecelebs kept watch so that Leopold Shadowizard could sleep. Then Leopold kept watch so that Otto could. Neither slept. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Shadowizard. Leopold Shadowizard read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet went through Leopold Shadowizard's sleeve at R-F8 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Jonas Steini of the Concord (@steini10.02). Victory at Hill 304. Leopold Shadowizard let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Leopold Shadowizard no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Leopold Shadowizard was hit through the chest at R-F8. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac of the Concord (@samhatespeace). Leopold Shadowizard looked over the parapet at R-F8 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac of the Concord (@samhatespeace).

Teodor Shadowizard had heard about Leopold Shadowizard's courage. At R-F8, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Teodor Shadowizard's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Teodor Shadowizard was waiting. Jonas Miked was grazed.
Teodor Shadowizard fired once through the steel loophole at R-F8 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Casimir "Button" Batman was badly wounded.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F8 in the middle of the night. Teodor Shadowizard met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Wendel Goober of the Concord (@local_hafu_goober).
Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard arrived carrying the family name of Teodor Shadowizard. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Viktor Thompson was grazed. Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard ate breakfast without a word. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard is number 124. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-F8 changed before the cheering ended. Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard shouldered another load. Now serving as a stretcher bearer, Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
some_like_it_fly: Bastian Fly arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying his mother's thimble and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A bullet grazed Bastian Fly's ribs at S-R8. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Edmund Mcnamara of the Concord (@zidane_mcnamara). Victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian Fly let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Bastian Fly is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. A letter from home reached Bastian Fly before dusk. Bastian Fly read it twice and slept a little easier. The new duty roster listed Bastian Fly as a signaller. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bastian Fly shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
teeganblair: By the time Zeno "Bones" Teeganblair reached P-F12, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Zeno "Bones" Teeganblair traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F12 with the rations. Zeno "Bones" Teeganblair ate while listening to the revised orders.
walkem.down.weir: Emil "Doc" Weir introduced himself as a brewer from Varenne. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F11, Emil "Doc" Weir listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Emil "Doc" Weir helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Emil "Doc" Weir wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
